stories.title: Anthropic shares slump on second day of trading as markets reel from AI sell-off
stories.take: Day two was the hangover: Anthropic shares slumped as Asian markets posted their worst week since 2020 and investors questioned the huge sums pouring into the AI build-out.

stories.title: Behind Jensen Huang’s exit, questions about a management style reportedly built on fear
stories.take: Behind Jensen Huang's exit, reporting describes a management style built on fear — Musk's claim that Nvidia staff 'love' the ousted CEO is not holding up.

stories.title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang’s ties with China
stories.take: California AG Rob Bonta subpoenaed Nvidia over Huang's ties with China, saying the company may have misled investors — the Huang story is now a legal one.

stories.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
stories.take: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68 billion — a steep discount from the roughly $12 billion Intuit paid in 2021.

stories.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
stories.take: Google gave Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you — organizing files, filling forms and running multistep workflows — as the agent race moves onto the desktop.

stories.title: Valve says it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines
stories.take: Valve warns it might have to raise the price of supply-limited Steam Machines: 'We don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price.'

stories.title: A human liver has been kept alive outside the body for a record seven weeks
stories.take: Researchers in Australia kept a human liver alive outside the body for a record seven weeks — a biomedical milestone with big transplant implications.

stories.title: Hearts United Wins $110M Pinterest Media AOR in First Pitch Since Launch
stories.take: Hearts United won Pinterest's $110M media AOR in its first pitch since launch, after a competitive review covering the U.S. and UK.

stories.title: Inside Nike’s plan to turn creators into brand builders
stories.take: Inside Nike's plan to turn creators into brand builders: Nike wants athletes and creators to help build its culture, not just sell its products.

stories.title: In Graphic Detail: Welcome to the agentic commerce quarter
stories.take: Welcome to the agentic commerce quarter: OpenAI, Google, Amazon and Walmart are betting on agent-led holiday shopping — Digiday charts how far it still has to go.

stories.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
stories.take: Walmart is working out what advertising even is in an agentic shopping world, where the buyer doing the browsing may be a bot.

stories.title: Media Briefing: ChatGPT’s new business hub is an early ‘search console moment’ for publishers
stories.take: ChatGPT's new business hub is an early 'search console moment' for publishers — its AI visibility and click data can now inform GEO strategy.

stories.title: LinkedIn Taps Former Trade Desk Exec to Lead Global Ad Sales
stories.take: LinkedIn tapped former Trade Desk exec Anders Mortensen to lead global ad sales, five months after his exit from the DSP.

stories.title: Lillard scores 33 points in Milwaukee return as Blazers beat Bucks
stories.take: Damian Lillard scored 33 in his first game back in Milwaukee, leading Portland past the Bucks team that waived him in 2025.

stories.title: Wemby debuts 'shunk,' part jump shot, part dunk done with reason
stories.take: Wemby debuted the 'shunk' — part shot, part dunk — because dunking gave him a blister; even his workaround is a highlight.

stories.title: Redick cites fatigue as Luka's shot goes cold, Lakers' win streak ends at 9
stories.take: The Lakers' win streak ended at nine in Utah: Luka shot 10-of-28 with nine turnovers and called his own performance 'unacceptable,' with Redick citing fatigue.

stories.title: 'I love the clutch': 76ers rally, improve to 11-0 in tight games
stories.take: The 76ers rallied from 17 down to beat Orlando and improve to 11-0 in clutch games — nobody in the league is closing like Philly.

stories.title: NBA One-Month Superlatives: MVP, top rookie, best surprise and fresh title predictions
stories.take: One month in, CBS hands out superlatives — MVP, top rookie, best surprise and fresh title predictions for a strange, fun 2026-27 start.

stories.title: What NBA insiders see from Boozer, Dybantsa and seven other top rookies
stories.take: What insiders see from Boozer, Dybantsa and seven other top rookies after month one — Windhorst and MacMahon canvass the league.

stories.title: Manfred says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
stories.take: Manfred says owners won't accept any deal without a salary cap — MLB is on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Yankees moves heating up, plus latest on Tarik Skubal, Padres, Mets, more
stories.take: Hot stove Friday: Yankees moves are heating up, with the latest on Tarik Skubal, the Padres and the Mets.

stories.title: Sources: Loáisiga back to Bronx after agreeing to 2-year deal
stories.take: The Yankees reunite with Jonathan Loáisiga on a two-year deal with a club option for 2029, reinforcing the bullpen.

stories.title: 'Legend' Pete Rose receives posthumous presidential pardon from Trump
stories.take: Trump posthumously pardoned Pete Rose, more than two years after Rose's death and a year after MLB reinstated him.

stories.title: Rockies trade for ChiSox's Castillo, Martin
stories.take: The Rockies acquired Luis Castillo and Davis Martin from the White Sox — Chicago quickly moved on from Castillo in a salary dump.

stories.title: Coveted May excited to tap into young 'energy' with White Sox
stories.take: Dustin May signed with the White Sox for three years and $52.5 million, saying he wants to tap into the young team's energy.

stories.title: Judge issues 14-day extension of order blocking Trump's triumphal arch construction
stories.take: A federal judge extended the order blocking Trump's triumphal arch for 14 days, calling the project in earlier proceedings a rushed job lacking a legal basis.

stories.title: 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit
stories.take: Three takeaways from the first-ever Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit in China — a historic sit-down that left major issues on the table.

stories.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
stories.take: Sen. Ron Johnson rejected tying government funding to ending the Iran war — 'We're not going to shut down the war' — as a shutdown deadline looms next month.

stories.title: International Court of Justice finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
stories.take: The ICJ found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya — the first time the court has found a state responsible for genocide.

stories.title: Do you need a measles booster shot now that the U.S. has lost its elimination status?
stories.take: The U.S., Mexico and Bolivia lost measles-free status this week after stubborn outbreaks erased decades of progress — PBS explains who needs a booster.

stories.title: Iran war has permanently reshaped energy priorities, IEA report says
stories.take: The IEA says the Iran war will leave lasting marks on the world's energy sector and has permanently reshaped energy priorities.

stories.title: Cop31 live: factious climate talks enter overtime without new draft deal in sight
stories.take: COP31 ran into overtime in Antalya with no new draft deal in sight — fossil fuels and climate finance remain deeply divided, and activists called it the 'worst COP ever.'

stories.title: Why L.A.'s early-morning 4.2-magnitude earthquake didn't ping your phone
stories.take: A 4.4-magnitude earthquake rattled L.A. early Friday near Commerce — and the LA Times explains why it didn't ping your phone.

stories.title: California just elected its most diverse group of lawmakers yet
stories.take: California just elected its most diverse group of lawmakers yet — for the first time, women will hold an equal share of seats in the statehouse.

stories.title: El Niño is here. This flood-prone town’s insurance pilot was a state model — then it fell apart
stories.take: El Niño is here, and Isleton's flood-insurance pilot — once a state model for flood-prone towns — fell apart just as the risk arrived.

stories.title: California subpoenas Nvidia as questions about CEO affair, AI chips mount
stories.take: California subpoenaed Nvidia as questions mount over the CEO affair and AI chips; Bonta's office will evaluate whether Nvidia violated California law.

stories.title: Arellano: Orange County was once California's Republican heaven. Democrats have painted it blue
stories.take: Orange County was once California's Republican heaven — Democrats have now painted it blue, and Arellano says don't call it purple anymore.

stories.title: High tides, big storms: Next week will be key test as El Niño pounds California coast
stories.take: King tides from Sunday through Black Friday, plus big swells and rain, will be a key test as a very strong El Niño pounds the California coast.

stories.title: 'Staggering' rail heists targeted dozens of L.A. trains, netted $22 million in shoes, other goods, feds say
stories.take: Feds say a rail-heist crew cut into more than 70 cargo containers on L.A. trains and stole over $22.5 million in shoes and other goods.

stories.title: The Democrats’ Plan for Investigating Trump
stories.take: The plan, in four areas: 1) the Trump family, 2) ICE/DHS pay-to-play around Noem and Lewandowski, 3) corporate corruption as it develops, and 4) the Epstein investigation • Incoming Oversight chair Robert Garcia's filter: the most serious corruption with a legislative purpose, so probes can end in new ethics laws • Tactics for expected stonewalling: immediate document requests and hearings, court referrals for contempt, and state AGs — a pardon does not protect in state court

stories.title: Abusers convicted in Joanne Young case echoing Pelicot
stories.take: Four men were convicted at Winchester Crown Court of raping Joanne Young, who was drugged by her husband Philip Young over 13 years; he had admitted 56 offences • The CPS calls it the first English case convicting men recruited by a husband this way, echoing France's Pelicot case; Young waived anonymity • Also: Anthropic's Wall Street debut and what its huge valuation means for AI

stories.title: UK agrees deal on closer cooperation with EU
stories.take: UK and EU agreed a reset on food standards, emissions and youth mobility — the biggest change since Brexit, but not rejoining the single market or customs union • Besieged Taiz in Yemen: up to a million trapped, health system near collapse, UN warns of a human rights catastrophe • COP31 draft drops fossil fuels entirely; Russia fired ~100 missiles and 400 drones at Kyiv, killing nine • A RAS-targeting drug left no visible cancer in 5 of 61 pancreatic patients — promising, not yet a cure

stories.title: G.T.A. VI Is a Monumental Human Achievement
stories.take: GTA VI is 'a monumental human achievement': ~$1.5B in presales, 212GB, built by nearly 5,000 Rockstar staff over 13 years with no AI assistance, per Rockstar • The detail is quotidian — a full gym, a dog that rides a jet ski, 60 bird species across a recreated Miami-Dade • Reality is now hard to satirize, so the tech saturation moved inside the gameplay itself

stories.title: How an American AI Company Uses Chinese Open-Weight Models
stories.take: The answer: Minerva uses frontier closed models like Claude to BUILD its product, and fine-tuned Chinese open-weight models (Qwen) to RUN repeatable production tasks • Method: a few thousand graded examples, fine-tuned via Fireworks for as little as ~$90 a run — faster and better at that task than the general model • Saeedi's ranked reasons: 1) cost/margin, 2) sovereignty — your data improves your model, 3) leverage for value-based pricing from OpenAI/Anthropic

stories.title: We Investigate Life Surge HQ: Tim Tebow, Multilevel Marketing and the DOJ
stories.take: Life Surge's celebrity draw is collapsing — Tebow, Mazzulla, Magic Johnson, Ortiz and Dungy have dropped out since the investigation began • Attendance is down by more than half, from ~4,000 a day to under 2,000, and Impact class rooms lose two-thirds by day two • The funnel: free-ish events feed a $97 class, then SurgeU packages over $10,000 — students allege pressure to open credit cards and tap home equity

stories.title: LA Olympics will bring billions to law enforcement
stories.take: LA 2028 Olympics security could cost $3–4 billion — LAPD and Sheriff estimates, double Paris 2024 — on top of a Games bill already at $7.3B vs the $5.3B originally pitched • Dr Lucy Jones on El Niño: equatorial temps higher than ever recorded, stronger atmospheric rivers, and next year likely the hottest on record • Floods have killed several times more Southern Californians than earthquakes, Jones notes

stories.title: Aswath Damodaran On Nvidia’s Collapse & Anthropic’s $1.5T IPO
stories.take: Damodaran splits Nvidia's fall in two: the personal scandal is small; the China allegations are the danger — hearings, scrutiny and possibly losing half to two-thirds of China sales • A CEO change alone is worth ~3–5% short-term; Nvidia is now a bet on how China resolves, trading at ~11x forward earnings • His Anthropic revaluation: ~$1.35T / $77 a share, cut from $1.475T on data-center politics and regulatory drag • His Nvidia stance: diversified only, with a limit buy at $140

stories.title: What Trump, Putin and Xi Left on the Table
stories.take: What was left on the table: AI controls — no agreement, definitions or guardrails at the summit itself, despite AI being the central U.S.–China competition • Also left: no war ended and no nuclear treaty from the ~80-minute Trump-Putin-Xi meeting • Trump said afterward he and Xi agreed in principle that 'some minimal guardrails' on superintelligent AI would be good, but 'didn't get into definitions'

stories.title: Tech blackouts, Black Friday fake-outs, and C-suite tariff cash-outs
stories.take: Tech blackouts: outages hit United, the FAA, Apple and the NSA in one week — not cybercrime, per the companies, but spiking flaw counts in old unpatched software • Black Friday fake-outs: a Groundwork analysis found many Amazon 'deals' priced the same or higher than the month before; Amazon disputes it as cherry-picked • C-suite tariff cash-outs: at least nine companies are using tariff refunds partly for executive bonuses instead of customer refunds, per ProPublica

stories.title: Overnight 4.4 earthquake, At least 1 dead in SoCal storm, "Granddaddy" of LA train robberies— Morning Edition
stories.take: A 4.4 quake near Commerce rattled LA before 3:30 a.m., felt as far as Lancaster and Poway, with no immediate damage reports • Yesterday's storm is blamed for at least one death — a woman swept away in a Chino Hills flood channel; Bel Air got nearly four inches of rain • More than a dozen arrested in what the DA calls the 'granddaddy' of LA train cargo theft prosecutions • South LA Council District 9 is still too close to call, 87 votes apart

stories.title: The week everything fell apart
stories.take: The week's cascade: an FAA nationwide ground stop, United and Microsoft outages, a Chase banking scare and an iCloud update that downed iCloud, the App Store and AppleCare • Apple's Home View smart display disappoints — it cannot run your Shortcuts, widgets cannot update, and it even claimed it had no camera • GTA VI praise is near-universal; Nilay queued the 2:30 a.m. download

stories.title: Government Funding Pressure On Iran War, National Security & Tech, Iowa Detonation
stories.take: Senate Democrats led by Tim Kaine want the stopgap funding bill — due by Dec 11 to avoid a shutdown — to end Iran war funding, arguing Trump started the war without congressional authorization • Republicans say pulling funding endangers troops and may force a party-line reconciliation bill • Also: the new national cyber chief after the outage week, and the Army's delayed lead-azide detonation in Iowa

stories.title: You Can Now Order a Cybercab***
stories.take: You can now order a Tesla Cybercab — the episode's headline gadget, in Waveform's last recording from Studio 4 • Gemini in Android Auto kept mangling a simple texted ETA, and Google renamed Gemini Spark to Gemini Tasks, colliding with Google Tasks • Apple's iPhone Duo got 2D face unlock — explicitly not Face ID, unusable for payments, and spoofed by a photo 1 time in 20

stories.title: U.S. Floats NATO Membership for Ukraine
stories.take: The U.S. float: full NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for giving up the rest of the Donbas — Putin told Kushner and Witkoff he would stop the war for that territory • Scenario two: NATO-like Article 5 guarantees in a treaty outside NATO, which Kushner says Russia is comfortable with — with no sign from Russia itself • Zelensky is not ruling it out but wants a real, backed offer and a referendum; Macron embraced talks, Germany resisted
